description: This file defines an Android activity named AutoComplete6 that displays a MultiAutoCompleteTextView for selecting multiple countries with comma-separated tokens. It initializes the view with a predefined list of country names.

classes.name: AutoComplete6
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates a MultiAutoCompleteTextView with country name suggestions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity layout, initializes the ArrayAdapter with country names, and configures the MultiAutoCompleteTextView with a comma tokenizer.
